text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, D-dimer). There is also monocytosis and basophilia. Coagulation is mildly impaired (INR elevated). These findings suggest significant systemic inflammation, possible infection, and increased risk of coagulopathy. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., infection, hematologic disorder, hypoxic respiratory failure) are recommended.
